Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.blockmanagement

Class SequentialBlockGroupIdGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.util.SequentialNumber
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.blockmanagement.SequentialBlockGroupIdGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.hadoop.util.IdGenerator
@Private public class SequentialBlockGroupIdGenerator extends org.apache.hadoop.util.SequentialNumber
Generate the next valid block group ID by incrementing the maximum block group ID allocated so far, with the first 2^10 block group IDs reserved. HDFS-EC introduces a hierarchical protocol to name blocks and groups: Contiguous: {reserved block IDs | flag | block ID} Striped: {reserved block IDs | flag | block group ID | index in group} Following n bits of reserved block IDs, The (n+1)th bit in an ID distinguishes contiguous (0) and striped (1) blocks. For a striped block, bits (n+2) to (64-m) represent the ID of its block group, while the last m bits represent its index of the group. The value m is determined by the maximum number of blocks in a group (MAX_BLOCKS_IN_GROUP). Note that the nextValue() methods requires external lock to guarantee IDs have no conflicts.
